 Advertisement Updated: 5:31 PM EST Nov 14, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raphael Tavernier Meteorologist Coldest air of the season expected Saturday night for the Gulf Coast
 Updated: 5:31 PM EST Nov 14, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raphael Tavernier Meteorologist FORT MYERS, Fla. — Expect a chilly night across the Gulf Coast, as lows dip below the 50-degree mark for some communities. The coldest air of the season has made its way down the state, bringing widespread 50s and 40s. No rain is expected.
 Tomorrow will be a chilly start with wake-up temps in the lower 50s and upper 40s for inland communities. Mostly sunny skies are expected through the day. Winds will begin to pick up from the east during the afternoon, thus starting our warming trend.
 Advertisement Next week will be warmer, windier, and also feature increasing moisture with small rain chances.
